title: 636017 Move Projects report action tooltips to report objects
summary: Report action tooltips for Projects reports are moved from page actions to the report objects themselves, reducing duplication and ensuring consistent tooltips across all report invocations.
key_points: 27 Projects reports now have tooltips defined at the report level
Duplicate tooltips removed from page actions in pages like Job Card, Resource Card, and role centers
Changes propagated to all country layer forks to maintain consistency
Metadata-only change with no runtime behavior or breaking changes
Follows the same cleanup pattern already applied to other system areas
quote: Moves the report action ToolTips for the Projects (Jobs & Resources) reports off the page actions that run them and onto the report objects themselves
